environment.topology: single-node replica set; standalone negative control; isolated crash/restart replica set

coverage.receipt: A standalone is rejected; contract/manifest/migration and delivery-policy metadata are pinned; the aggregate-revision and idempotency-scope indexes are observed as unique.
Five injected precommit boundaries leave aggregate, event, receipt, authority, provenance, and outbox collections empty.
An uncertain acknowledgement is reconciled by command ID and exact retry returns the committed sentinel.
The receipt survives client/application restart and abrupt mongod termination followed by recovery on the same data directory.
Thirty-two same-aggregate contenders produce one aggregate, event, receipt, and outbox record.
A valid materialized snapshot matches its ordered event fold; a direct conflicting projection write is detected.
One backlog intent and one intent committed after feed open are both observed through the converged feed.
Twenty-four claimants produce one epoch-1 holder; yield/reacquire increments to epoch 2 and stale resolution fails.
Readdress is holder/epoch pinned and byte-equivalent aggregate state is observed before and after delivery mutation.
The first expired lease is released and the second reaches a finite dead-letter terminal state.
A change-stream resume token is persisted and a restarted feed observes the later unresolved intent.
A configured one-intent recovery ceiling exposes ErrBacklogLimit on the second unresolved backlog record instead of silently truncating or scanning without bound.
Change-stream history loss is classified for resynchronization while authorization and ordinary infrastructure failures remain terminal to the operation.
Mongo and the accepted hermetic reference expose structurally equal semantic snapshots after the same decision.
Unbounded commit and claim operations fail before I/O with ErrDeadlineRequired.
